findings.highlight: they're going to be distributing more copies
findings.evidenceJa: 問屋から増版が決まったとの連絡も来ています
findings.explanation: The wholesaler has notified the bookstore that a reprint has been approved. Todokanai TL reduces this concrete second printing to generic distribution of more copies.
findings.japanese:
「問屋から増版が決まったとの連絡も来ていますし、
それほどお待たせすることもないと思いますが…」
findings.todokanai: "The wholesaler has contacted us saying that they're going to be distributing more copies, so I don't think you'll need to wait long…"

findings.highlight: The reservations across the bookstores have completely exceeded our expectations… even all the samples have been sold.
findings.evidenceJa: 書店の発注数がこっちの予想を完全に越えててな…サンプルも全部持ってかれたんだよ
findings.explanation: Bookstores' wholesale order quantities exceeded the publisher's forecast, so even the sample or complimentary copies were taken for allocation. Todokanai TL turns trade orders into consumer reservations and claims the samples were sold.
findings.japanese:
「書店の発注数がこっちの予想を完全に越えててな…
サンプルも全部持ってかれたんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "The reservations across the bookstores have completely exceeded our expectations… even all the samples have been sold."

findings.highlight: not even the people who created this album can get their hands on their own work
findings.evidenceJa: 作った本人たちすら手に入らない
findings.explanation: The object being launched and sold out is the Ensemble special issue, which includes the mini-album. Todokanai TL narrows the creators and unavailable work to the album alone.
findings.japanese:
その記念すべき発売日に知らされた真実は、
作った本人たちすら手に入らないという、
ある意味ものすごい朗報だった。
findings.todokanai: The fact that not even the people who created this album can get their hands on their own work is, in a way, elating news worthy of a commemoration.

findings.highlight: printing three times the amount we initially decided for the issue
findings.evidenceJa: それでも本誌の３倍刷ったんだから
findings.explanation: They printed three times the circulation of the regular magazine, not three times an earlier planned quantity for this special issue. The comparison explains why the sellout was genuinely unforeseeable.
findings.japanese:
「編集長、満面の笑顔で営業を怒鳴り倒してたな。
それでも本誌の３倍刷ったんだから、
出荷数ミスったとも言い切れないんだけどな」
findings.todokanai: "Our chief editor was actually fuming at the sales department with a wide smile on his face. Even so, we ended up printing three times the amount we initially decided for the issue, so we can't say that the problem was with production numbers."

findings.highlight: the high expectations the public has of Kaiousha
findings.evidenceJa: 開桜社の見込みの甘さというか、普段のアンサンブルの見くびられ方というか
findings.explanation: Haruki wryly blames Kaiousha's naive forecasting and how badly Ensemble is normally underestimated. Todokanai TL turns the publisher's underestimation into high public expectations.
findings.japanese:
ついでに、開桜社の見込みの甘さというか、
普段のアンサンブルの見くびられ方というか…
findings.todokanai: While I'm at it, I'm not sure if all this is due to the high expectations the public has of Kaiousha, or the fact Ensemble is usually underrated among the public…

findings.highlight: "You see, this is something my friends have told me about, but some additional pop songs have been added into the album for some reason. They even come with vocals and everything."
findings.evidenceJa:
「それがさ、友達に教えてもらったんだけど、
ボーナストラックになぜかポップスが入ってるんだって。
それもボーカル付きで」
findings.explanation: The bonus track contains one pop song with vocals; Todokanai TL pluralizes it into multiple added pop songs — The family still locates the seventh track correctly.
findings.japanese:
「それがさ、友達に教えてもらったんだけど、
ボーナストラックになぜかポップスが入ってるんだって。
それもボーカル付きで」
findings.todokanai: "You see, this is something my friends have told me about, but some additional pop songs have been added into the album for some reason. They even come with vocals and everything."

findings.highlight: "Not only that, some of the songs aren't just played by Touma Kazusa, but even composed by her too. People are talking about it all over the internet."
findings.evidenceJa:
「しかも冬馬かずさが
ピアノだけじゃなく作曲もしてるらしいんだ。
ネットじゃかなり話題になってんだよ」
findings.explanation: Kazusa both plays piano and composed the bonus song; 'some of the songs' again pluralizes the single track — Her composition credit remains clear.
findings.japanese:
「しかも冬馬かずさが
ピアノだけじゃなく作曲もしてるらしいんだ。
ネットじゃかなり話題になってんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "Not only that, some of the songs aren't just played by Touma Kazusa, but even composed by her too. People are talking about it all over the internet."

findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちの『付属祭』のために
findings.explanation: Setsuna coins 付属祭 as the trio's private reprise of the school festival, echoing the affiliated-school name and earlier performance. Generic 'high school festival' removes the quotation-marked coinage and fails to explain Haruki's sudden recognition. An English edition needs a new callback compatible with its standardized University High School terminology rather than a literal affiliation pun.
findings.japanese: 「頑張ろうね…わたしたちの『付属祭』のために」
findings.todokanai: "Let's do our best… for the sake of our 'high school festival.'"

findings.explanation: Haruki answers Kazusa's command to follow her lead with 'Leave it to me/us.' Todokanai TL instead says Haruki will count on Kazusa, reversing who accepts responsibility for the performance.
